# Portenv

> Encrypted, portable workspaces for developers and their agents. Each project gets a workspace ("box") that moves between your Mac, your own servers and later Portenv's cloud, and that agents with their own computers can work in, on your terms.

## What it is

- A native Mac app.
- Open-source core: the runner, the in-box agent and the save format are Apache-2.0.
- Works with your own servers and storage, without a Portenv account.

## Status

- In development. Not yet available to download.

## Agents

- Built for agents with their own computers, like Grok Bot, ChatGPT Dots and Meta Muse.
- Connections start with SSH and a CLI with a published skill.
